mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% YoY signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 > 3% YoY growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window for UNRATE < 4.5% instances.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO (Industrial Production) and HOUST (Housing Starts) both show YoY growth above 5%, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances with both proxies > 5% YoY growth.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during late-cycle expansions, a 3-month decline in RSAFS (Retail Sales) signals impending demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window for late-cycle RSAFS decline instances.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: high CPIAUCSL (CPI) readings (> 250) are associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to inflation concerns.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window for CPIAUCSL > 250 instances.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a sudden increase in UNRATE (> 1% in 2 months) signals labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of UNRATE surge instances.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO growth is above 3% YoY and PAYEMS (Nonfarm Payroll) growth is below 1% YoY, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days due to supply chain imbalances.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window for instances with specified proxy conditions.
